title: CIPS no-size-cap negative replicates on fresh seed 4: starved condensates coarsen to 90 bodies of mean 108 px by t=3000 (reservoir 174 of 56 px), with 0-1 splits against 87-207 merges and no shells
summary: Ran c23's CIPS world.py unchanged on fresh seed 4, 256^2, T=3000, in the starved regime (DF 0.05, kF 0.5, y 3) and the reservoir twin (hold 1). Starved: 156 -> 107 -> 90 bodies at t=1000/2000/3000, mean area 50 -> 89 -> 108 px, 95th percentile 92 -> 190 px, 1 persistent split and 87 merges. Reservoir: 251 -> 194 -> 174 bodies, mean 38 -> 56 px, 0 splits and 207 merges (coarsening_seed4.txt). starved/sheet.png: round condensates and short rods coarsen with no rings or shells and no fission. Matches the finding's t=3000 numbers (starved 82-93 bodies of 104-119 px, reservoir 167-170 of 57-58 px).

observations.finding: coarsening_seed4.txt: starved 90 bodies / mean 108 px at t=3000, reservoir 174 / 56 px; splits 1 and 0 against merges 87 and 207; starved/sheet.png shows no shells and no fission

seeds_run.result: pass (negative reproduced): starved bodies coarsen 2x larger than the reservoir, 0-1 splits, no shells

controls_run.finding: reservoir/ (hold 1) against starved/ on the same seed

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed, run to t=3000 (not 4000). The enzyme rim/core and the dispersion analysis were not repeated. The fed arm was not re-run here (my seed-4 fed run of 20261957-era review is at t=2500).
